nothing_selected: Select an object, wall or corner to edit its dimensions.
coordinates: One X Y pair per line, in metres. Counterclockwise; no holes.
draw_help: Click corners; click the first corner or press Enter to finish. Esc cancels.
place_help: Click in the room to place furniture, or press Enter to place it at the centre.
opening_help: Click a wall, or select a wall in Properties and press Enter. Adjust the exact position in Properties.
plan_help: Drag to move · corner handle: resize · round handle: rotate · middle/right drag: pan · wheel: zoom
view_help: Drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
checks_note: Geometric estimates only. These checks do not certify building-code compliance or accessibility.
title: Project name
update_idle: Updates are checked against the official RoomPlanner repository.
up_to_date: You have the latest compatible version.
update_failed: Could not check for updates. Try again later.
download_failed: Could not download or verify the update.
install_failed: Could not install the update. Your current installation is preserved.
invalid_geometry: Invalid geometry. Check wall lengths, intersections and opening positions.
invalid_coordinates: Enter at least three valid X Y coordinate pairs.
io_error: Could not read or write the file. Check the location and access permissions.
settings_load_error: Saved settings could not be read. Defaults are in use.
recovered: Recovered the previous saved version from the backup. Save a copy to keep it.
delete_blocked: Remove the openings on adjacent walls before changing this corner.
new_help: Replacing the outline removes its openings. Furniture stays at its current coordinates.
about: Plan a room before you buy
shortcuts: Ctrl+S save · Ctrl+Z undo · Ctrl+Y redo · Delete remove · Esc cancel
measure: Measurements use the inner wall faces.
update_restart: The app will restart. Save any project changes first.
startup_failed: RoomPlanner could not start. The details below can help identify the cause.
